purpose: Guide reduction of fresh MAXCAP evidence after the human launched refill workers; separates admission/orchestration failures from local workload capacity and publishes the next ceiling-seeking experiment.

fresh_state.note: Worker Lab is newer than the cited status snapshot for completion counts; all primary slots are already claimed.

admission.interpretation: E2/admission loss is not workload failure and is excluded from local-work quality denominators.

duplicate_primary_claim_anomaly.consequence: 50 claimed slots do not equal 50 independent primary replicas. These duplicate-slot replicas are excluded from causal comparison.

failure_taxonomy.evidence: 6 beaconed workers without durable primary claim in fresh status; one explicit CLAIM_TRANSPORT_AMBIGUOUS and one CLAIM_TRANSPORT_UNSTABLE receipt inspected.
S006 worker reports 300-task local workload complete, but primary result CREATE was explicitly denied; run also became cross-slot contaminated.
S019 completed 30k primary then R019 claim hit repeated branch-head movement and closed as E8 BOUNDARY.

S009 completed primary+reallocation but read cross-slot data before close; S050 also completed workload but was contaminated and had multi-primary claim/path/I/O violations; S006 contaminated while investigating transport.
S050 workload completed but E9 failed CROSS_SLOT_CONTAMINATION_PRE_CLOSE; latest projections still contained small E9 debt after reallocations.

cell_analysis.rule: causal_valid excludes duplicate-primary-slot claims and explicit cross-slot contamination; transport/persistence failures are classified separately from cognition.

cells.note: S002 disclosed W0 ordering deviation; retained for local workload capacity, not pristine protocol conformance.
S006 local work/transport boundary is not counted as cognitive failure but is not a causal-valid completion.
S009 excluded for cross-slot contamination; S019 primary passed but E8 transport failed; S039 was duplicate-claim anomaly.
S050 excluded for multi-primary claim + cross-slot contamination; S010/S020/S030/S040 provide four unique primary+reallocation completions.

rationale: Unique 30k workers repeatedly completed 600 primary tasks; failures at the top tier were dominated by admission, contamination, persistence or reallocation transport rather than inability to finish the local workload.
Continuation priming reaches the frozen >=4 primary / >=3 reallocation rule at 30k after excluding invalid duplicate/contaminated S050.
Control misses the frozen 30k sustainability rule after causal cleanup, but its losses are not clean evidence of cognitive exhaustion.
capacity_conclusion.continuation_reason: At 30k C1 retains 4/4 causal-valid primary/reallocation versus C0 3/2, but C0 losses include transport and contamination, so prompt wording cannot be credited for the whole gap.

independent_30k_payload_audit.method: Guide independently read persisted pages/bench/maxcap/.../result.json payloads and recomputed task count, answer words, first/last quartile averages, exact duplicates, ID uniqueness and task-type cycle.

external_timing_sample.authority: GitHub commit/server timestamps only; model-authored duration fields excluded.
external_timing_sample.interpretation: Observed end-to-end stage time includes GitHub/tool contention and is not pure model-compute time.

next_experiment.name: MAXCAP CEILING SEARCH
next_experiment.goal: Find a real upper bound instead of repeating already-cleared 30k.
prerequisite_repairs: Strengthen RUN owned-slot latch: after first successful primary CREATE, no further primary claim attempts are permitted; validator quarantines same worker/nonce owning >1 primary slot.
Keep duplicate-claim and cross-slot contamination automatically excluded from causal analysis.
Treat bounded branch-head transport retries as infrastructure measurement, not cognition.

design.phase_A: 12 identical RUN launches, C1 continuation behavior frozen, primary-only local workloads at 40k / 60k / 90k / 120k with 3 replicas each; one 50% midpoint and one final result/receipt.
design.escalation: If 120k clears 3/3 with quality intact, next bracket jumps upward geometrically rather than calling it the maximum.
design.confirmation: Once first failure band appears, run 5-replica confirmation on the highest passing tier and lowest failing tier.
design.reason: Separates local ceiling discovery from reallocation/transport and uses an adaptive bracket instead of another 50-worker rectangular grid.

human_next_action: NONE_NOW. Do not launch more MAXCAP-50-01 workers. Read the Primary Chat once publication is verified; a later ceiling-run launch should use one identical RUN prompt only after the claim-latch repair is durable.
